Baseline/test conditions are explicit but not captured.

Capture Type 1 normal as baseline and Types 2-6 as test conditions.
Preserve grouping by date, line, type, position, wait time, and sample set.
Remove invalid outcomes measurement-3 through measurement-8.
Apply 1.9kgf spec to tension outcomes and recalculate violations.
